title: character.json
description: One cast member, stored at Characters/<folder>/character.json inside a trial. The engine reads id, name and surname; the rest is profile data the editor shows and the trial's bio screens use. Unknown properties are allowed, so a newer editor's field does not make an older one reject the file.

formatVersion.description: "<major>.<minor>". Absent in files written before this field existed, which are treated as the current major.

id.description: Referenced by trial.json's characters list, by speaking lines, and by minigame payloads. Same shape rule as every other id, because it reaches inline event handlers in the editor.

position.description: Cast slot, 0-16. 16 is the headmaster bench.
